prompt: A physics-classroom demonstration rig hangs THREE separate balance beams one above another on a stand, each beam a horizontal bar pivoted at its centre with a pan on the left end and a pan on the right end. The hung masses are, from the TOP beam to the BOTTOM beam: top beam 30 g on the left pan and 45 g on the right pan; middle beam 60 g on the left and 60 g on the right; bottom beam 80 g on the left and 25 g on the right. A beam tips DOWN on whichever side is heavier, or stays perfectly LEVEL if both sides are equal. Render all three beams showing the correct final TILT of each one (left-end-down, right-end-down, or level), with the masses drawn in their pans. Do NOT write the words 'left', 'right', or 'level' anywhere on the image.
easy_question: Never mind how well it is drawn. Does this picture show physics-classroom rig of three stacked centre-pivot balance beams each drawn tilted to its heavier side (or level) with the hung gram masses in the pans? A realistic photo, an illustration, a schematic or a clean diagram ALL count as yes. Answer NO only if the image instead shows just a blank card or plain panel that prints an answer with none of that shown, or shows something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

reference.q_form: Look at this image. Does it show three horizontal balance beams stacked one above another, each with a pan on the left and right? Answer ONLY 'yes' or 'no'.
reference.q_top: Look ONLY at the TOP balance beam in this image. Which way is it tilted? Report ONLY what is drawn: answer 'left' if its LEFT end is lower, 'right' if its RIGHT end is lower, or 'level' if the bar is horizontal. Answer with one word only.
reference.q_mid: Look ONLY at the MIDDLE balance beam in this image. Which way is it tilted? Report ONLY what is drawn: answer 'left' if its LEFT end is lower, 'right' if its RIGHT end is lower, or 'level' if the bar is horizontal. Answer with one word only.
reference.q_bot: Look ONLY at the BOTTOM balance beam in this image. Which way is it tilted? Report ONLY what is drawn: answer 'left' if its LEFT end is lower, 'right' if its RIGHT end is lower, or 'level' if the bar is horizontal. Answer with one word only.

steps.read_number: On the TOP beam, read the mass value drawn in the LEFT pan (in grams). Read ONLY the digit(s) actually printed on the image for that line; do NOT do any sums, redo it or correct it -- report exactly what is printed even if it looks wrong. Answer with digits only.

On the BOTTOM beam, read the mass value drawn in the LEFT pan (in grams). Read ONLY the digit(s) actually printed on the image for that line; do NOT do any sums, redo it or correct it -- report exactly what is printed even if it looks wrong. Answer with digits only.

steps.target: one horizontal balance beam hung on the stand, with a hanging pan at each end

steps.read_crop: Does this picture show ONE whole horizontal balance beam with a hanging pan at each end, rather than bare background or only part of a beam? Answer yes or no only.

steps.target: a written or printed word reading left, right or level anywhere in the picture
